## f67822970902

**Finding: the task-local portable test suite has a deterministic resource-path defect.**
The assigned generator hash is
`faf3648742828cc68826afd5accafb6c707fa540df14004a42b354425979d5d1`.
Running the supported `task_tests` stage produced **13 passes and 1 failure**. The failing test
sets its root to the generator directory and then attempts to read
`data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl` below that directory. In the staged runtime this becomes
`/tmp/arcpuzzles-check-.../generators/f67822970902/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`, raising
`FileNotFoundError`. Exact command output and the source-bound runtime manifest are in
`checks/audit/f67822970902/task-tests/result.json`.

I separately checked whether that harness failure concealed a generator-semantic defect.
`checks/audit/f67822970902/probe.json` loads the canonical ledger from the correct shared
location: all 3 canonical inputs pass the validator and the Python mirror matches all 3
outputs. It then checks 16 draws per band and 12 cyclic lesson windows per band: zero
structural failures, every draw has a strict-interior template plus full and clipped stamps,
all four rotation codes appear, and 0/36 lesson windows have an identifiable-rival failure.
The generator lint stage also passed (`checks/audit/f67822970902/lint/result.json`).

Accordingly, the concrete audit issue is the test's non-portable path, not a demonstrated
semantic failure in the generator. No audit-target source was modified. A separately attempted
long semantic-gate run was externally interrupted and is not represented as a pass.
